## What's New in v2.1.0

### 🎉 New Features

- **TUI Sidebar Widget** — Real-time performance monitoring directly in the OpenCode sidebar
- **Sliding Window Average** — Smoothed stats using sliding window averaging for more stable metrics
- **Build System** — Added build script and dist output for streamlined publishing
- **Format & Stats Utilities** — Extracted reusable formatting and statistics helpers
- **Toast Notifications** — Real-time performance summary after each LLM response

### 🔧 Fixes & Improvements

- Web mode compatibility via `client.app.log()`
- Normalized repository URL format
- Added JSX support in tsconfig

### 🌐 Localization

- **Chinese (简体中文)** documentation added (`README.zh-CN.md`)

### 🧪 Tests

- Rewritten tests for format and stats functions

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Howardzhangdqs/opencode-throughput/compare/v1.0.0...v2.1.0

## Release v1.0.0

- Initial release of opencode-throughput plugin
- Real-time LLM performance monitoring (TTFT, TPS, latency)
- Toast notifications after each LLM response
- JSONL logging to `~/.opencode/throughput.jsonl`
- Built-in `benchmark` tool for querying historical stats
- Per-model aggregation of token usage and cost

### Installation

Add to your `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["opencode-throughput"]
}
```

### Update Instructions

```bash
rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules/opencode-throughput
opencode
```
